title: 第二十三 章 争夺第 二十四章 碧眼金雕
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆引风见状，也将自己的一些东西交给了她。
“四姐，倘若真如大哥所言，还望你能托人照顾一下陆行真，拜托了。”陆引风一脸认真的说道。
尽管事情尚未发生，但看到大哥和弟弟如此郑重其事，陆引慧心里满是不是滋味。
“五弟，你放心，若真到了那一步，姐一定会照顾好他的。”陆引慧同样认真的回应道。
“好啦！时间也耽误不少了，咱们赶紧去找找吧，免得夏家人怪罪。”陆引浩说道。
随后，三人只是大致查看了一番，便匆匆返回了聚集地。
“夏前辈，我们那边检查完毕，并无任何发现。”陆引浩恭敬的行礼说道。
“嗯。”
夏临渊只是轻声应了一下，连眼皮都未曾抬起。
陆引浩三人默默退下，与其他已经回来的人站在一起，静静等待着尚未归来的同伴。
不多时，又陆陆续续回来了一些人，同样都表示没有发现。
夏临渊不禁一脸失望，甚至开始怀疑自己是不是弄错了地方。
就在这时，不知哪个家族的人急匆匆的跑了过来。
此人气喘吁吁的说道：“夏……夏前辈，前……前……前面有发现。”
“在哪？快，快带路！”
听到有发现，夏临渊眼中瞬间闪过一抹亮光，他迫不及待地祭出飞剑，带上这人便疾飞而去。
“玄洲，你带着其他人尽快赶过来。”
夏临渊的声音在空气中悠悠回荡，而他人早已消失得无影无踪。
夏玄洲见状，只能带着众人朝着夏临渊的方向赶去。
当他们赶到时，只见夏临渊正站在一处山洞前，脸色格外凝重。

山洞中隐隐散发出一股力量，竟让他莫名心悸。
都已经来到这里了，况且结丹的希望近在咫尺，无论山洞里有什么，他都决心闯上一闯。
“玄洲，你来布置阵法。”夏临渊吩咐道。
“是。”夏玄洲应道。
他迅速从储物袋中取出两个阵盘，熟练地分别布置了一个隔音阵法和一个隐蔽阵法。
夏临渊回头扫视众人一眼，说道：“你们就在此处好好守着，等我回来。”
“是，夏前辈。”众人齐声应道。
随后，夏临渊和夏玄洲踏入了山洞之中。
洞内幽暗无光，不时传来阵阵奇怪的叫声。
“大哥，里面该不会有三阶妖兽吧？”夏玄洲忍不住低声问道。
“玄洲，你也感受到了？”
夏玄洲默默点了点头。
“都走到这一步了，我们还有放弃的理由吗？机会就在眼前。”
夏临渊眼神坚定，语气中透着不容置疑的决心。
夏玄洲沉默不语，他深知，在结丹的巨大诱惑面前，没有一个人能够轻易抗拒。
随着两人继续深入，山洞内渐渐变得宽敞起来。
在山洞的最深处，一头二阶圆满的苍鹰静静卧着。
它的身下，有一枚乳白色的蛋，蛋上时不时闪烁出金色的光晕。
这苍鹰刚刚生产完毕，此刻身体虚弱到了极点，精元大量流失。
而在苍鹰身侧丈许外的岩壁上，一株半人高的果树傲然挺立。
content_en:
Seeing this, Lu Yinfeng also handed some of his things to her.
"Fourth sister, if it's true as the elder brother said, I hope you can ask someone to take care of Lu Xingzhen, please." Lu Yinfeng said seriously.
Although the incident has not happened yet, Lu Yinhui felt uncomfortable seeing her eldest brother and younger brother taking matters so seriously.
"Fifth brother, don't worry, if it really comes to that point, I will take good care of him." Lu Yinhui responded equally seriously.
"Okay! We've lost a lot of time. Let's go look for it quickly so that the Xia family won't blame them." Lu Yinhao said.
Afterwards, the three of them just took a general look and hurried back to the gathering place.
"Senior Xia, we have completed the inspection and found nothing." Lu Yinhao said with a respectful salute.
"Yeah."
Xia Linyuan just responded softly without even raising his eyelids.
Lu Yinhao and the other three quietly retreated and stood together with the others who had returned, quietly waiting for their companions who had not yet returned.
Not long after, some people came back one after another, and they all said they didn't find anything.
Xia Linyuan couldn't help but look disappointed, and even began to wonder if he had gone to the wrong place.
At this moment, someone from an unknown family hurried over.
The man gasped and said: "Xia...Senior Xia, there was something discovered in front of...before...in front of you."
"Where is it? Quick, lead the way!"
Upon hearing the discovery, Xia Linyuan's eyes flashed with light. He couldn't wait to use his flying sword, took the man and flew away quickly.
"Xuanzhou, take the others and come here as soon as possible."
Xia Linyuan's voice echoed in the air, but the others had already disappeared without a trace.
Seeing this, Xia Xuanzhou could only lead everyone in the direction of Xia Linyuan.
When they arrived, they saw Xia Linyuan standing in front of a cave, his face extremely solemn.
There was a faint power emanating from the cave, which actually made him feel palpitations for no reason.
He was already here, and the hope of forming a pill was very close at hand. No matter what was in the cave, he was determined to try it.
"Xuanzhou, you come and set up the formation." Xia Linyuan ordered.
"Yes." Xia Xuanzhou responded.
He quickly took out two formation disks from his storage bag and skillfully arranged a sound-proof formation and a concealment formation respectively.
Xia Linyuan turned around, glanced at everyone, and said, "Just stay here and wait for me to come back."
"Yes, Senior Xia." Everyone responded in unison.
Afterwards, Xia Linyuan and Xia Xuanzhou stepped into the cave.
The cave was dark and lightless, and strange sounds could be heard from time to time.
"Brother, is there a third-level monster inside?" Xia Xuanzhou couldn't help but ask in a low voice.
"Xuanzhou, do you feel it too?"
Xia Xuanzhou nodded silently.
"We have come this far, do we have any reason to give up? The opportunity is right in front of us."
Xia Linyuan's eyes were firm, and his tone revealed unquestionable determination.
Xia Xuanzhou remained silent. He knew very well that no one could easily resist the huge temptation of forming pills.
As the two of them continued to go deeper, the cave gradually became more spacious.
In the deepest part of the cave, a second-level perfect goshawk lay quietly.
Under its body, there is a milky white egg, with a golden halo flashing from time to time.
The goshawk had just given birth and was extremely weak at the moment, losing a lot of energy.
On the rock wall about ten feet away from the goshawk, a fruit tree half as tall as a man stood proudly.
